reviews.summary: Reviewed the cumulative Change for Completeness, Correctness, Coherence, and Cleanliness. Two contract violations remain: read-only validation can accept a Delta that archive rejects, and a case-insensitive path collision can be misreported as a stale baseline. HEAD did not move.
findings: CRITICAL — Read-only validation and delivery disagree on operation-less Element declarations. The Change permits these only when the declaration matches Formal and requires the same check for read-only validation and delivery (.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/change-sync.md:23–25; tasks.md:73,76 in that Change directory). The compiler makes the check opt-in (src/core/change-compiler.ts:152–158; src/core/model/delta.ts:105–109). Archive and `validate --change` opt in (src/core/change-sync.ts:57–66; src/commands/validate.ts:199–206), but `arch validate --change` and both JSON `show` paths do not (src/commands/arch/validate.ts:14–21; src/commands/show.ts:49–56,94–103). In a read-only run of committed code, changing only a Definition without an operation yielded `arch validate` success while archive preparation rejected it with `MISSING_OPERATION`. The regression test covers only `validate --preview` (test/commands/validate.test.ts:146–158); `git grep -n -E 'MISSING_OPERATION|navigation-only declaration|Unstated change to the definition' HEAD -- 'test/commands/arch*' 'test/commands/show*' 'test/integration/arch*'` returned no matches.

CRITICAL — An added unit that aliases an existing Formal unit on a case-insensitive filesystem is reported as a stale snapshot rather than a collision identifying both owners and paths, as required by .xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/change-sync.md:39–41. The transaction checks destination preimages before calling the alias check (src/core/model/transaction.ts:274–286,392–407); the alias check is where both owners and paths are available (src/core/change-sync.ts:111–114; src/core/model/sync-writer.ts:126–137). With simulated case folding, adding `ARCHIVE-ROLE` beside existing `archive-role` reproduced `Prepared sync is stale` despite an unchanged baseline. No Formal writes occurred. The current regression adds two new aliases, so both preimages are absent and the test misses this branch (test/core/archive.test.ts:500–528).

reviews.summary: Reviewed the cumulative Change for Completeness, Correctness, Coherence, and Cleanliness. Four blocking defects remain in archive preservation, Delta validation, and Formal model application. HEAD remained unchanged.
findings: CRITICAL — Archive can report success after corrupting a POSIX symlink target. `src/core/archive.ts:60-73` reads link targets as UTF-8 strings and recreates them from those strings; `src/core/archive.ts:90-97,120-123` then commits the archive and removes the original. A virtual-filesystem probe of committed `moveDirectory` changed the legal target bytes `66 80` to `66 ef bf bd`. This violates the original-artifact guarantee in `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/design.md:15-16` and the symlink correction in `tasks.md:30`. Add a regression that compares raw target bytes.

CRITICAL — A leading normative heading outside any Section operation is silently discarded. `src/core/parsers/section-blocks.ts:187-211` skips the first H1 without validating its content. A committed-source probe placed `# The system SHALL not expose private notes.` before a valid ADDED block; notation validation succeeded and the compiler emitted only the later Section. Archive uses these checks at `src/core/change-sync.ts:62-79`, so it can seal a Change while dropping the heading. This violates `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/change-sync.md:23-25` and `tasks.md:76`. The rejection fixtures at `test/core/archive.test.ts:351-378` and `test/commands/validate.test.ts:168-173` cover unscoped prose, but not this bypass.

CRITICAL — Delivery treats ordering differences in unordered fields as semantic differences. `src/core/change-compiler.ts:83-85,96-129` compares already-applied targets without normalizing unordered fields, and `src/core/model/sync-writer.ts:72-79,100-104` compares serialized View units. A committed-source probe with Formal `include: [child, root]` and Delta `include: [root, child]` rejected ADDED as a conflict and scheduled a rewrite for MODIFIED. Both outcomes contradict the unordered-set contract in `.xirang/model/elements/deterministic-operations.md:115-117` and the no-rewrite guarantee in `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/change-sync.md:17-19,31-33`. Use semantic equality before rejecting or scheduling a write.

CRITICAL — A case-only replacement reports a stale baseline instead of identifying the two aliased units. `src/core/model/sync-writer.ts:72-85,126-137` probes only paths present in the final target, so it misses an existing unit scheduled for removal. A case-folded virtual filesystem with REMOVED `foo` and ADDED `Foo` produced a write/delete manifest and reached `src/core/model/transaction.ts:280-286,404-406`, which reported only that `Foo.md` had changed, although the baseline had not. This leaves `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/tasks.md:79` unmet. The existing regression at `test/core/archive.test.ts:531-559` covers an existing unit retained in the target, not one removed by the same Delta.

reviews.summary: 已审查累计 Change 的完整性、正确性、一致性和整洁性；审查期间 HEAD 未变化。提交快照中的 331 项定向测试通过，2 项 Windows 专用测试跳过。独立复现确认归档复制会拒绝带合法 POSIX 文件名的制品，并放宽原目录权限。
findings: CRITICAL — 合法的 POSIX 制品文件名会阻止三种模式封存。`src/core/archive.ts:59-75,93-103,253-264` 用 UTF-8 字符串读取目录项，再用解码后的名称访问原文件。独立复现：名称字节为 `66 80` 的普通文件存在，但复制尝试访问 `f�` 并报 ENOENT。这违反 `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/change-archive.md:15-23,61-63` 的原样封存要求。`test/integration/archive-workflow.test.ts:46-54` 只验证链接目标字节；`git grep -nEi 'readdir.*buffer|non.utf.?8.*(filename|name|artifact)|(filename|name|artifact).*non.utf.?8' HEAD -- test` 无匹配。

CRITICAL — 成功封存可能放宽制品的访问权限。`src/core/archive.ts:59-66,88-100` 用默认权限重新创建归档根目录和子目录，未继承源目录权限。独立复现：原本仅所有者可进入的 `0700` 制品目录封存后变为 `0775`，使原先靠父目录保护的文件可被其他用户访问。这与 `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/change-archive.md:15-23` 的原样封存要求不符。`git grep -nEi 'artifact director(y|ies).*(mode|permission)|archive.*directory.*(mode|permission)|(mode|permission).*archive.*director' HEAD -- test` 无匹配。

CRITICAL — Windows junction 保真测试不能检出链接类型退化。`src/core/archive.ts:36-47,67-71` 区分 junction 与目录符号链接，但 `test/integration/archive-workflow.test.ts:56-71` 只断言归档项是链接、目标文本一致、目标创建后可解析为目录。在允许创建目录符号链接的环境中，把 `junction` 改为 `dir` 仍可满足这些断言。应直接比较原件与归档件的 Windows `LinkType`，以覆盖 `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/tasks.md:59`。

CRITICAL — 入门文档仍把应用 Delta 描述为所有归档的结果。`docs/getting-started.md:107-115` 无条件说明归档会应用 Section 变更，`docs/concepts.md:560-567` 的术语表也把 Archive 限定为交付并更新模型。这与 `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/change-archive.md:19-23` 的放弃模式矛盾。应将这些描述限定为默认和 quick 交付，并说明 `--abandon` 只留档。

reviews.summary: Reviewed the cumulative Change for Completeness, Correctness, Coherence, and Cleanliness. HEAD stayed unchanged. The Expected Semantic Model still gives Archive conflicting Quality responsibilities, and two filesystem edge cases break promised archive or retry behavior.
findings: CRITICAL — Coherence: The Expected Semantic Model still requires Archive to handle missing baseline Reviews, incomplete delegations, and stale validation using Apply's optimization and recovery guidance (.xirang/model/elements/quality-execution-model.md:18–20). The new Archive Quality Gate instead requires Archive to hand missing evidence back to Apply, and the generated workflow explicitly forbids rechecking Review or Opt (.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/archive-quality-gate.md:13–23; src/core/templates/workflows/archive-change.ts:139–145). `git ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD .xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/quality-execution-model.md` returned no Delta unit; compiling the committed Delta confirmed that the contradictory Section survives in the target.

CRITICAL — Correctness: The pending-marker name makes otherwise valid archive names unusable and can hide legacy archives. A legal 244-character Change name produces a 255-byte dated directory name but a 264-byte marker name (src/utils/change-utils.ts:50–89; src/core/archive.ts:100–104, 271–273; src/core/archive-paths.ts:3–5). On the inspected filesystem, the former admits lookup while the latter returns ENAMETOOLONG. New delivery and abandonment fail at reservation; retry propagates the same error, and archived completion silently omits the legacy entry (src/core/archive.ts:189–205; src/utils/item-discovery.ts:45–57). This violates the existing-history guarantee in .xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/design.md:13–16, 23. `git grep -niE 'ENAMETOOLONG|NAME_MAX|repeat\(24[0-4]\)|long (change|archive).*name' HEAD -- test/core/archive.test.ts test/integration/archive-workflow.test.ts test/commands/output.test.ts` found no regression coverage.

CRITICAL — Correctness: A claim left by an exited local archive blocks later calls if the OS reuses that PID for an unrelated live process. The claim identifies its owner only by hostname and PID, and `process.kill(pid, 0)` proves only that some process has that PID (src/core/archive.ts:154–177). That contradicts the explicit guarantee that an exited local owner's claim does not block a retry (.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/design.md:19–21). The existing test covers an exited PID that remains unused, not a replacement owner (test/core/archive.test.ts:290–308); `git grep -niE 'PID reuse|reused PID|process id reuse' HEAD -- test` returned no matches.

reviews.summary: Reviewed the cumulative Change for Completeness, Correctness, Coherence, and Cleanliness. HEAD remained unchanged. Default and quick delivery can archive a Delta other than the one they applied, or silently omit a valid Delta unit. Two recovery and collision diagnostics also miss explicit requirements.
findings: CRITICAL — The snapshot digest does not distinguish file boundaries. `src/core/model/transaction.ts:348–356` concatenates paths and raw contents using NUL delimiters, but file contents can contain NUL. An in-memory probe of the committed function confirmed that removing a second Delta file and appending its delimiter, path, and bytes to the first produces exactly the same digest. `src/core/change-sync.ts:57–66,85–100` and `src/core/archive.ts:353–358` therefore allow a change made during confirmation to pass revalidation, apply the old plan, and preserve the new files in history. This violates design decision 2 and the recheck required by `tasks.md:67`. The existing regression at `test/core/archive.test.ts:1181–1194` covers a text edit, not a change to file boundaries.

CRITICAL — The documented pathname for a legal leading-dot identity can make its Delta disappear. `.xirang/references/xirang-artifact-semantic-delta.md:28–35,57–68` permits leading dots, and `src/core/templates/workflows/propose.ts:91–98` directs authors to `elements/<identity>.md`. The reader at `src/core/model/parser.ts:394–413` skips `elements/.feature.md` before inspecting the declared identity. With a valid Formal model, `src/core/change-sync.ts:57–79` and `src/core/validation/validator.ts:125–127` can treat that Change as having no Delta and archive it successfully without applying the entry. The existing test at `test/core/archive.test.ts:501–518` uses non-dot source filenames, so it does not cover the documented authoring path.

CRITICAL — Relationship-container case aliases are rejected without the conflicting identities required by `tasks.md:79,81`. `src/core/model/sync-writer.ts:111–140` assigns every container the same owner label, so the diagnostic prints only two paths and two copies of 'relationship container'. Paths need not encode the identities of their entries. An in-memory case-folding probe confirmed the omission; `test/core/archive.test.ts:566–598` checks both owners only for Element declarations.

CRITICAL — A retry with a restored active Change and a marked partial destination never tells the user to inspect the incomplete archive. `src/core/archive.ts:127–145` can restore the source but leave the destination and marker when destination cleanup fails. On a same-day retry, `src/core/archive.ts:298–311,332–337` reports only 'already exists'; it checks for a pending marker on lookup only when the active directory is absent (`src/core/archive.ts:223–239`). The contract at `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/change-archive.md:53–55` explicitly requires workspace-inspection guidance. `test/core/archive.test.ts:796–827` exercises a retry only when source restoration also failed.

reviews.summary: 审查了完整 Change 的 Completeness、Correctness、Coherence 和 Cleanliness。发现一处可绕过 Delta 校验的解析缺陷，以及一处归档排他写入缺少有效回归测试。审查期间 HEAD 未变化。
findings: CRITICAL — 普通和 quick 交付均可能接受混入退役 `RENAMED` 操作的 Delta。`src/core/parsers/section-text.ts:10-55` 把左侧缩进四个空格的三个反引号误识别为 Markdown 围栏起点，导致 `src/core/parsers/section-blocks.ts:187-219,230-250` 将后续未缩进的 `## RENAMED Sections` 吞入前一个合法 Section。用 HEAD 中的解析器进行内存验证，`unsupportedSections` 为空；Formal 解析器使用同一围栏规则，也将该标题读入 Section 正文，因此 `src/core/change-sync.ts:76-84,114-120` 的往返检查不能发现它。这违反 `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/tasks.md:21,47,58`。现有 `test/core/parsers/section-blocks.test.ts:22-51` 只覆盖真正的围栏和未被遮蔽的 RENAMED 标题；对测试搜索 `invalid (opening )?fence|indented (code|fence)|four.spaces|commonmark|backtick.*info` 无匹配。

CRITICAL — 逐项排他复制缺少能发现覆盖行为的测试。`.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/tasks.md:50` 明确禁止复制覆盖已存在的符号链接，`src/core/archive.ts:94-102` 依赖 `COPYFILE_EXCL` 落实此约束。`test/integration/archive-workflow.test.ts:40-56,166-190` 分别覆盖根目录已存在、在空目标目录复制链接、注入复制失败及禁止 rename 到目标，但都未让普通文件复制遇到已占用的目标子路径。删除 `COPYFILE_EXCL` 不会触发这些断言。对测试搜索 `COPYFILE_EXCL|copy (collision|onto.*link)|occupied (child|entry)|exist(ing|s).*destination (child|entry)|replace.*(archive|destination).*symlink` 无匹配。应验证该冲突使归档失败、活动 Change 得以恢复，且链接指向的文件内容保持不变。

WARNING — 归档重试能查找已放弃历史，但历史补全只枚举交付目录。`src/core/archive.ts:231-247` 查询两个位置，`src/commands/completion.ts:287-291` 则仅调用 `src/utils/item-discovery.ts:40-63`，后者不进入 `abandoned`。对测试搜索 `archived.changes.*abandon|abandon.*archived.changes` 无匹配。Change 明确禁止补全列出半成品，但未明确要求补全列出所有已完成的放弃记录；建议确认预期。

reviews.summary: Reviewed the cumulative Change across Completeness, Correctness, Coherence, and Cleanliness. The delivery gate rejects valid Section content and accepts malformed non-Element Delta units. The concurrency tests do not verify exclusion between separate CLI processes. HEAD remained unchanged.
findings: CRITICAL — Delivery rejects a valid Section whose normative prose follows a subheading. The authoring reference allows subheadings and requires SHALL or MUST in the Section body before any Acceptance Case (.xirang/references/xirang-artifact-semantic-delta.md:37–44, 69–77). The model parser retains an ordinary `#### Rules` subheading and its prose (src/core/model/parser.ts:107–125), but the notation check that now gates delivery stops at any heading (src/core/change-sync.ts:76–79; src/core/validation/validator.ts:197–209; src/core/parsers/section-text.ts:60–79). A read-only probe against HEAD compiled the Section successfully, then received `ADDED "Feature" is missing Section text` from the delivery notation gate. Check for normative prose up to the first actual Acceptance Case, not the first arbitrary heading.

CRITICAL — Invalid non-Element Delta units can pass delivery. The Change requires rejection of empty operation blocks and illegal notation, and REMOVED entries carry identity only (.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/change-sync.md:17–25; .xirang/references/xirang-artifact-semantic-delta.md:37–40, 46–54). `parseDeltaContainer` accepts a `relationships: []` Delta as zero operations, and `parseDeltaUnit` drops every parser diagnostic for REMOVED units, including `VIEW_BODY_UNSUPPORTED` (src/core/model/delta.ts:158–186; src/core/model/parser.ts:261–267, 292–313). The secondary validation only inspects Element bodies (src/core/validation/validator.ts:39–45, 125–129, 239–245). A read-only HEAD probe confirmed both gates accepted the empty container and also accepted a REMOVED View with an illegal Section body; the latter produced a removal. Reject these inputs before any write and test that Formal and the active Change stay intact.

CRITICAL — Workspace exclusion lacks regression evidence for a live competing CLI process. The contract requires independent archive invocations to exclude one another, including after both pass preflight (.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/change-archive.md:25–31, 57–59; .xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/tasks.md:78). Both contention tests instantiate `ArchiveCommand` in the same process, while the PID tests cover an exited child or a mismatched identity for the current PID (test/core/archive.test.ts:291–309, 333–343, 966–1058). A mutation that treats all different local PIDs as stale would survive these tests while defeating cross-process exclusion in src/core/archive.ts:193–228. `git grep -n -Ei '((spawn|fork|execFile).*(archive)|archive.*(spawn|fork|execFile)|(child|process|pid).*(contend|competi)|(contend|competi).*(child|process|pid))' HEAD -- test tests` returned no matches; the broader archive-lock search located only the cases cited above. Add a test that holds the first process in its commit window and verifies that a second process cannot write Formal or archive a Change.

WARNING — The current CLI reference still identifies schemaVersion 4 as the Quality record format (docs/cli.md:344–356). Default Archive consumes a version 5 record and rejects version 4 without migration (src/core/quality/engine.ts:63–76, 130–150, 341–346). Update the reference so migration users are not directed to an unsupported Seal format.

reviews.summary: Reviewed the cumulative Change for Completeness, Correctness, Coherence, and Cleanliness. HEAD remained unchanged. Two blockers remain: an indented Acceptance Case can bypass Section validation, and archive completion cannot discover abandoned history.
findings: CRITICAL — An indented Markdown Acceptance Case can make an invalid Delta deliverable. The notation requires SHALL or MUST in the Section's own body, before any Acceptance Case (.xirang/references/xirang-artifact-semantic-delta.md:37–44). The shared extractor skips headings indented up to three spaces but only stops at an unindented Acceptance Case; the model parser uses that same unindented pattern (src/core/parsers/section-text.ts:6–8,60–76; src/core/model/parser.ts:105–123). A read-only probe against committed HEAD confirmed that archive preparation rejects a Section whose only SHALL is under a flush-left Acceptance Case, but accepts the same input after indenting the heading three spaces. The prepared Formal unit round-trips with zero Acceptance Cases. Both default and quick use this preparation path (src/core/archive.ts:345–365; src/core/change-sync.ts:76–84). A committed test search for indented Acceptance Cases returned no matches.

CRITICAL — Archived-history completion omits every completed abandonment, including names at the component limit. Required Corrections 64 and 85 cover completion of finished history and exclusion of pending history (.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/tasks.md:64,85). Archive lookup searches both history directories (src/core/archive.ts:231–245), but `__complete archived-changes` calls a helper that scans only the delivery directory and never descends into `abandoned` (src/commands/completion.ts:287–292; src/utils/item-discovery.ts:40–60). A read-only probe with one completed archive in each location returned only the delivered archive. The completion tests cover delivered history only (test/commands/output.test.ts:196–226); the long-name test for abandonment checks the move but not discovery (test/core/archive.test.ts:312–330).

WARNING — The opening of the Archive concept guide still describes all archiving as verifying and syncing a Delta, and later says every archive preserves an approved Delta (docs/concepts.md:458–462,496–508). The mode-specific instructions below are correct; label the opening and model-evolution statements as delivery-only so they do not contradict abandonment.

reviews.summary: Reviewed the cumulative Change for Completeness, Correctness, Coherence, and Cleanliness. HEAD was unchanged. Delivery can archive a malformed Semantic Delta by treating an invalid removal as already applied.
findings: CRITICAL — Validate removal identities before applying the already-applied exception. The contract requires identity validation and permits no-op delivery only for a legal Delta whose target is already present (`.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/change-sync.md:17–25`); the authoring schema requires `[A-Za-z0-9._-]+` (`schemas/semantic-model/schema.yaml:63–75`). The parser accepts any nonempty declaration identity and any nonempty relationship tuple (`src/core/model/parser.ts:164–173,314–328`), and the Delta parser accepts those values in REMOVED entries (`src/core/model/delta.ts:90–112,168–226`). The compiler then suppresses the missing-target error because the invalid identity is absent, and validates only the resulting model (`src/core/change-compiler.ts:117–131,151–166`). A read-only run of the committed code confirmed that both compiler and notation validation passed with zero operations for all four declaration types using `identity: bad identity`, and for a relationship removal with a malformed endpoint. Both default and quick delivery use this preparation path (`src/core/archive.ts:345–366`; `src/core/change-sync.ts:57–85`), so after other gates pass the invalid Change can leave active state with a successful archive receipt. Preserve idempotence for valid absent targets, but reject malformed identities before suppression and add a regression test asserting the Change remains active and neither Formal nor history changes. `git grep -nEi 'INVALID_IDENTITY|invalid identity|bad identity|malformed identity' HEAD -- test/core/archive.test.ts test/integration/sync-workflow.test.ts test/integration/archive-workflow.test.ts test/commands/output.test.ts test/commands/validate.test.ts` returned no matches.

reviews.summary: Reviewed Completeness, Correctness, Coherence, and Cleanliness across the cumulative Change. HEAD was unchanged. The TypeScript build and 446 targeted tests passed on Linux, but a live archive claim incorrectly blocks completed-history lookups, and the workflow tests do not protect the required Git handoff boundaries.
findings: CRITICAL — Completed-history lookup is incorrectly subject to the workspace commit lock. Design decision 1 exempts existing-archive lookups from gates, and decision 3 limits the claim to commit and compensation (.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/design.md:13–15). The archive contract requires returning an existing path when the Change is no longer active (.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/change-archive.md:19–29). Instead, src/core/archive.ts:294–308 checks for a competing claim before taking the read-only history branch; the actual commit path already checks claims at src/core/archive.ts:216–228 and 319–330. On the committed CLI, querying the same finished archive returned `alreadyArchived: true` with no claim but exited 1 with no stdout when an unrelated live claim was present. `git grep -nEi 'history.*(lock|claim)|((lock|claim).*(histor|existing archive))' HEAD -- test` returned no matching regression coverage.

CRITICAL — G4's workflow tests do not verify that abandonment skips delivery preparation or that a historical receipt stops Git handoff. Those boundaries are explicit in design decision 5 and G4 (.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/design.md:17,29; .xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/tasks.md:12–14). The instructions currently express both boundaries at src/core/templates/workflows/archive-change.ts:133–148, but test/core/templates/archive-change.test.ts:24–52 checks command strings, a prohibition, and the presence of the `alreadyArchived` token. Changing the dispatcher to run delivery preparation before abandonment, or changing the historical-result branch to continue into Git while retaining that token, would pass those assertions. The generated-skill test compares copies to the same template and would also pass (test/skills/archive-skill-content.test.ts:106–113). Verify the routing and stop conditions, not just the presence of their wording.

reviews.summary: Reviewed the cumulative Change for Completeness, Correctness, Coherence, and Cleanliness. HEAD remained unchanged. Three reproduced defects block approval: a no-Delta delivery can delete a Formal unit, a history lookup can report a rolled-back archive as complete, and two distinct POSIX Delta paths can collapse into one before validation.
findings: CRITICAL — A no-Delta delivery can silently delete an existing Formal file. `src/core/model/delta.ts:298–306` collapses duplicate Formal identities into maps before validation, and `src/core/change-compiler.ts:156–166` validates only the resulting target. `src/core/model/sync-writer.ts:81–94` emits the surviving unit; `src/core/change-sync.ts:80–84` schedules the omitted file for deletion. In a scratch workspace with two Formal files declaring the same root identity and a Change containing only `.delta-noop`, `archive --quick --yes` succeeded and deleted one of the files. This violates the no-write promise and the requirement for an explicit Element removal (`.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/change-sync.md:17–25`; retained contract at `.xirang/model/elements/change-sync.md:406–412`). The existing no-Delta test uses a valid, unique baseline (`test/integration/sync-workflow.test.ts:24–37`); a targeted test search for `duplicate.*formal|formal.*duplicat|no.op.*(duplicate|invalid.*identity)` returned no matches.

CRITICAL — Read-only history lookup and completion can report an archive that was rolled back. `src/core/archive.ts:135–153` removes the failed destination before removing its pending marker. A reader can list the destination before rollback, then check the marker after rollback and incorrectly return the now-missing path as `alreadyArchived` (`src/core/archive.ts:231–245, 297–307`). Completion has the same listing-to-marker gap (`src/utils/item-discovery.ts:40–51`). A controlled interleaving reproduced both false results while the original Change was active again. This violates `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/change-archive.md:23, 49–55` and Required Corrections 64 and 98 (`tasks.md:64, 98` in that Change). `test/integration/archive-workflow.test.ts:98–128` covers a marker that stays present, not one removed by rollback; a targeted test search for `history.*(roll.?back|stale.*entry)|pending.*(disappear|roll.?back)` returned no matches.

CRITICAL — POSIX path decoding can silently drop a valid declared Delta operation. `src/core/model/parser.ts:392–423` lists partition entries as UTF-8 strings, reopens them by decoded name, and keys the snapshot by that same string. On Linux, distinct files named `unit-<byte 0x80>.md` and `unit-�.md` collapsed to one snapshot entry. Archive reported success and preserved both source files in history, but applied only the second file's valid ADDED operation. The confirmation-time reread uses the same lossy snapshot (`src/core/change-sync.ts:57–66, 97–100`), so it cannot detect the omission. This violates the full-Delta compilation requirement (`.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/design.md:14`; `elements/change-sync.md:17–25` in that Change). `test/integration/archive-workflow.test.ts:159–179` verifies raw names during copying, not during Delta compilation; a targeted test search for `(non.UTF|raw.*(file|name)).*(Delta|model)|Delta.*(non.UTF|raw.*(file|name))` returned no matches.

reviews.summary: 审查了完整变更的完整性、正确性、一致性与清洁度。Linux 定向测试 358 项通过、2 项 Windows 专属测试跳过。另用已提交 CLI 独立复现了两处交付缺陷。审查期间 HEAD 未变化。
findings: CRITICAL — 合法的点开头 Delta 单元可能被静默丢弃。`.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/tasks.md:88` 要求预览和交付读取这类单元，`.xirang/references/xirang-artifact-semantic-delta.md:28–35` 规定文件名仅用于组织，但 `src/core/model/parser.ts:404–425,436–442` 只读取带 `.md`、`.yml` 或 `.yaml` 后缀的点文件。实测同一合法 ADDED 单元存为 `elements/.author-unit` 时，预览返回零条操作，quick 返回成功并封存 Change，却未新增 Formal 元素；只加 `.md` 后缀，预览即返回一条 ADDED。`test/core/archive.test.ts:555–573` 仅覆盖默认后缀和 `.tmp` 文件；`git grep -n -e '\.author-unit' -e extensionless -e suffixless HEAD -- test` 无匹配。

CRITICAL — 新单元可静默占用本次计划移除的另一 identity 的同一 Formal 路径。`.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/change-sync.md:23–25,39–41` 要求写入前拒绝路径冲突并指出双方；`tasks.md:79–81` 明确将计划移除的现存单元纳入检查。`src/core/model/sync-writer.ts:64–85,132–144` 合并原有与目标路径所有者时，精确同路径的原所有者被覆盖，无法进入冲突检查。实测 Formal 的 `elements/new-id.md` 声明 `old-id`；同一 Delta 移除 `old-id` 并新增 `new-id` 时，CLI 覆写该文件并成功封存。`test/core/archive.test.ts:621–653` 覆盖不同拼写的大小写别名，不覆盖精确同路径；`git grep -n -e path-reuse -e 'old-id.*new-id' HEAD -- test` 无匹配。

reviews.summary: Two reproduced defects prevent archive from reliably validating and applying the complete Semantic Delta. HEAD remained unchanged during review.
findings: CRITICAL — A malformed extensionless hidden Relationship Delta is silently omitted. `src/core/model/parser.ts:406–413,429–443` uses successful YAML parsing to discover hidden units, so `relationships/.edges` containing `relationships: [` disappears before validation. `src/core/change-sync.ts:61–79` then validates the incomplete snapshot. A disposable fixture using committed code produced a valid empty preview and a successful quick archive. This violates `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/change-sync.md:19–25` and `tasks.md:103` in the same Change. Recognize malformed authored units without treating them as absent, and test that preview and delivery both reject them. `test/commands/output.test.ts:109–131` covers only valid extensionless units and ignored staging files.

CRITICAL — Renaming Delta source files can change whether the same entries validate or are delivered. `src/core/model/delta.ts:267–275,323–330,368–383` sorts units by path and applies their entries in that order. In a committed-source probe, an ADDED Element and its ADDED Section in separate units compiled only when the declaration file sorted first. A second probe showed that quick delivery accepted an ADDED Section followed by removal of its host, silently discarding the Section; reversing the files rejected the Delta. This violates the complete, uniquely determined target required by `.xirang/model/elements/semantic-delta.md:12–17` and `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/change-sync.md:19–25`. Resolve declaration and Section dependencies by identity and reject contradictory targets independently of source order; add regression coverage for both orders.

reviews.summary: Reviewed Completeness, Correctness, Coherence, and Cleanliness across the cumulative Change. The committed Delta compiles into a valid Expected Semantic Model, but three cases still violate the archive or preview contract. HEAD did not change during review.
findings: CRITICAL — Delivery can reuse the exact Formal path of a different Relationship it removes. Required Correction at .xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/tasks.md:104 requires rejection with both identities. src/core/model/sync-writer.ts:111–136 merges previous and next Relationships into one path claim, so the ownership check never sees the conflict. A read-only probe of committed code put `root -[old]-> child` in `relationships/new.yaml`, removed it, and added `child -[new]-> root`. The compiler accepted the Delta and the writer prepared a replacement at that same path; the Formal round-trip also passed. test/commands/output.test.ts:205–218 covers exact-path Element reuse, and test/core/archive.test.ts:656–681 covers case aliases between Relationship paths, but neither covers this case.

CRITICAL — Malformed extensionless hidden Relationship input can disappear before validation, contrary to .xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/tasks.md:103–105. src/core/model/parser.ts:403–408 and 424–437 only discover an extensionless hidden Relationship when the recovered YAML document exposes a `relationships` key. A read-only fixture probe with `relationships/.edges` containing the authored `relationships` header but missing its colon discovered zero files and returned no compiler or preview error. Delivery consumes that same filtered snapshot at src/core/change-sync.ts:57–78, so it can archive the malformed Change as a no-op or apply only its other units. test/commands/output.test.ts:134–150 covers malformed values whose keys remain recoverable, not malformed keys.

CRITICAL — A leftover hidden writeback staging file alone lets `validate --change --preview` pass without a Delta or `.delta-noop`. src/core/model/parser.ts:403–404 and 424–437 correctly excludes the staging file from compilation, but src/core/validation/validator.ts:125–127 and 225–231 counts any file or directory as Delta presence. A read-only fixture probe confirmed an empty discovered Delta, no marker, and valid preview notation. This violates .xirang/model/elements/validation-commands.md:379–391 and the staging exclusion in .xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/tasks.md:88,103. test/commands/output.test.ts:109–131 includes real units alongside its staged file, so its assertions would not catch a staging-only false pass.

reviews.summary: Reviewed the cumulative Change for Completeness, Correctness, Coherence, and Cleanliness. Three reproduced defects remain: a stale claim can block Archive, delivery preflight can misreport a valid Delta as missing, and Expected Model writeback rejects a valid Section reversion. HEAD did not move.
findings: CRITICAL — A verifiably stale local claim can block every archive mode. `src/core/archive.ts:167–205` returns “live” immediately when `kill(pid, 0)` returns EPERM, without checking the process start identity. On Linux, the read-only reproduction got EPERM while `/proc` still exposed a start identity that differed from the claim; Archive nevertheless reported an active competitor. Design `design.md:19–21` and Required Correction 86 require proceeding when PID reuse can be verified and blocking only when it cannot. `test/core/archive.test.ts:334–345` uses the caller's own PID, so it does not cover EPERM. Check the recorded identity when it remains readable, and test both mismatched and unreadable identities after EPERM.

CRITICAL — The Archive workflow can falsely report a valid Semantic Delta as incomplete. `src/core/model/parser.ts:403–447` accepts a hidden authored unit such as `elements/.author-unit`, but `src/core/artifact-graph/outputs.ts:17–41` uses a glob that excludes dotfiles. That result determines completion in `src/core/artifact-graph/state.ts:14–41` and is reported by `src/commands/workflow/status.ts:22–37`. The Archive template uses this report to trigger an incomplete-artifact warning and confirmation (`src/core/templates/workflows/archive-change.ts:139–140`). The read-only reproduction compiled the hidden unit successfully but resolved no artifact outputs. `test/commands/output.test.ts:109–132` verifies preview and delivery for hidden units, while `test/commands/artifact-workflow.test.ts:162–188` checks `--no-quality` without a hidden-only Delta. Make artifact discovery agree with the accepted Delta inputs while excluding staging files, and cover both cases at the status boundary.

CRITICAL — Expected Model writeback cannot revert the last local Section change when another source owns a modified Declaration for the same Element. `src/core/expected-model-writeback.ts:61–75,122–145` correctly excludes the sibling-owned Declaration operation, but then serializes the edited Expected Declaration into the now-operation-free local unit. `src/core/model/delta.ts:117–121` rejects it because that placeholder differs from Formal. The read-only reproduction compiled the initial split Delta successfully, then returned `INVALID_TARGET` / `MISSING_OPERATION` when only the local Section was restored to Formal text. This breaks supported Section editing (`.xirang/model/elements/cli.md:150–169`). `test/core/expected-model-writeback.test.ts:81–91,158–169` covers cancellation and sibling Declaration ownership separately, not together. Write a Formal-matching placeholder when an existing Element's local operations are exhausted, and verify the sibling source remains unchanged.

reviews.summary: Reviewed the cumulative Change for Completeness, Correctness, Coherence, and Cleanliness. The committed snapshot built successfully and 348 focused tests passed on Linux, but two independently reproduced defects let delivery succeed without preserving the validated input or rejecting malformed Delta content. HEAD remained unchanged.
findings: CRITICAL — A symlink at a semantic partition root bypasses the ordinary-file boundary. `src/core/model/parser.ts:404–431` skips links encountered inside partitions but opens each partition root with `readdir` without checking whether the root itself is a link. Status also reports files outside the Change through `src/core/artifact-graph/outputs.ts:31–38`. In a Linux fixture, `validate --preview` and `archive --quick` accepted a Change whose `elements` partition was a relative symlink to a sibling directory. Formal changed, but the archive copied only the link, which was dangling at the new location (`src/core/archive.ts:85–102,124–131`): the applied Delta was absent from history. A separate fixture confirmed that a linked Formal partition let delivery rewrite a file outside the Formal tree, because the transaction checks the leaf but not its ancestors (`src/core/model/transaction.ts:419–457,499–505`). This violates the same-input and preservation guarantees in `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/design.md:13–16` and the link handling correction in `tasks.md:36`. Existing archive tests cover leaf links, not linked partition roots (`test/core/archive.test.ts:1188–1212`).

CRITICAL — A malformed Kind constraint is silently treated as an omitted field and can remove a Formal restriction. `src/core/model/parser.ts:103–105,218–255` drops non-list `parents`, `children`, `sourceKinds`, and `targetKinds` without a diagnostic; `src/core/model/delta.ts:181–204` then forwards the resulting target, and `src/core/model/validator.ts:101–120` can only validate constraints that survived parsing. In a Linux fixture, both preview and quick delivery accepted `children: capability` in a MODIFIED Element Kind. The Formal file previously had `children: [capability]`; delivery removed that restriction and archived the Change successfully. This violates the requirement to reject invalid Delta notation without writing (`.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/change-sync.md:17–25`). The nearby test checks valid list reordering, not malformed field types (`test/core/archive.test.ts:722–741`).

reviews.summary: 审查覆盖完整 Change 的 Completeness、Correctness、Coherence 和 Cleanliness。HEAD 未移动。已用该提交的源码复现两种非法 Delta 通过交付预检并生成 Formal 写入清单的情况。
findings: CRITICAL — 无标题的 Acceptance Case 可替代 Section 正文。`src/core/parsers/section-text.ts:6-8,60-80` 未将 `#### Acceptance Case:` 识别为正文边界，反而跳过标题并将下方的 SHALL 段落计入 Section 正文；`src/core/model/parser.ts:115-133` 同样将其当作正文保存。直接执行该提交的 `prepareChangeSync`，有标题的对照输入被拒绝，无标题输入却生成了 Formal 写入清单，违反 `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/tasks.md:92-95` 和 `schemas/semantic-model/schema.yaml:74-76`。`test/core/archive.test.ts:532-555` 只覆盖有标题的情况；`git grep -nF '\n#### Acceptance Case:\n' HEAD -- test` 无匹配。应拒绝畸形标题，并增加断言 Formal 和活动 Change 均不变的交付回归测试。

CRITICAL — Relationship Delta 容器会静默丢弃非法顶层操作。`src/core/model/parser.ts:304-325` 只取 `relationships` 字段，`src/core/model/delta.ts:207-246` 只校验列表项。包含顶层 `operation: RENAMED` 和一个合法 ADDED 三元组的 YAML 通过了 `prepareChangeSync`；生成的写入清单只包含新增三元组。这违反 `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/change-sync.md:17-25` 的完整 Delta 校验和操作限制。`git grep -nE '[Tt]op-level.*[Rr]elationship|[Rr]elationship.*[Tt]op-level|RENAMED.*[Rr]elationship|[Rr]elationship.*RENAMED' HEAD -- test` 无匹配。应在容器层拒绝不受支持的字段，并测试合法列表项不能掩盖非法顶层内容。

reviews.summary: Reviewed the cumulative Change for Completeness, Correctness, Coherence, and Cleanliness. Both delivery modes can archive malformed Delta input, and the Seal-only gate lacks a runtime regression test that distinguishes it from re-evaluating Review and Opt. HEAD remained unchanged.
findings: CRITICAL — A malformed Authored View can be delivered with different semantics from the submitted Delta. `.xirang/references/xirang-model-notation.md:6-16` defines `of` as one Element identity, and `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/change-sync.md:17-25` requires rejection of illegal notation before writing. `src/core/model/parser.ts:277-299` silently drops non-string `of`, so `src/core/model/validator.ts:234-250` never checks the reference. An in-memory probe using committed source accepted an ADDED view with `of: [not-present]` without diagnostics and serialized it without `of`; the target round-trip check also passed. Both delivery modes use this preparation path (`src/core/change-sync.ts:57-84`, `src/core/archive.ts:349-370`). Reject an explicitly malformed `of` and test that delivery leaves Formal and the active Change unchanged.

CRITICAL — An empty level-two Markdown heading can smuggle unscoped prose into the Formal Contract. `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/change-sync.md:23-25` requires Section operation prose to be scoped to a valid Section. `src/core/parsers/section-blocks.ts:187-211,230-250` does not recognize a bare `##` as a level-two boundary and instead absorbs it and following text into the previous Section. The Formal reader shares the blind spot (`src/core/parsers/section-blocks.ts:57-63`). An in-memory probe with a valid ADDED Section followed by bare `##` and stray prose passed compilation, notation validation, and the Formal round trip. Reject the malformed boundary before delivery; the existing invalid-Section cases at `test/core/archive.test.ts:426-455` exercise named unknown headings but not this case.

CRITICAL — The Seal-only runtime boundary lacks a discriminating regression test. `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/archive-quality-gate.md:17-23` assigns Review and Opt evaluation to Apply. `src/core/quality/engine.ts:341-345` correctly checks only the Seal commit after parsing the record, but the archive success cases at `test/core/archive.test.ts:220-265` use the fixture at `test/helpers/quality-fixture.ts:38-47`, which records Opt as not performed. Those tests would still pass if Archive re-ran `readQualityRecordStatus`, whose post-Opt ancestry checks can fail when earlier objects are unavailable (`src/core/quality/engine.ts:276-299,321-332`). `git grep -n -i -E 'seal.only|only.*seal|re.evaluate|recheck.*(review|opt)|graft|shallow' HEAD -- test` returned only template assertions at `test/core/templates/archive-change.test.ts:65-70`. Add a runtime case with a valid Seal commit but unavailable earlier Opt history.

reviews.summary: Reviewed the cumulative Change for Completeness, Correctness, Coherence, and Cleanliness. Three input-validation defects allow delivery to seal a Change after discarding, changing, or misclassifying authored content. Reproduced all three through ArchiveCommand built from committed HEAD with an in-memory filesystem. HEAD remained unchanged.
findings: CRITICAL — Unknown Delta frontmatter fields are silently discarded. An ADDED Authored View with `include: "*"` and a misspelled `autoLayot: TB` passes preview and quick delivery; the archived source retains the field, but the installed View omits it. `src/core/model/delta.ts:162-207` accepts the result of `parseUnit`, and `src/core/model/parser.ts:288-323` checks types for recognized keys but does not reject unknown keys. This violates the illegal-notation rejection and complete-target requirements in `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/change-sync.md:19-25`. `test/commands/output.test.ts:390-400` covers wrong types on recognized fields, not unknown keys.

CRITICAL — A level-one Markdown heading does not end a Section operation. After a valid `### Section: A`, an un-fenced `# Not an operation` and its prose are installed as part of A, and a subsequent `### Section: B` is installed as another ADDED Section. `src/core/parsers/section-blocks.ts:21-24,58-62,196-218,242-257` only recognizes level-two boundaries; the Formal reader shares that limitation, so the round-trip check in `src/core/change-sync.ts:48-54,114-120` accepts the wrong target. This violates the unscoped-content rule in `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/change-sync.md:23-25`. `test/commands/output.test.ts:402-407` covers empty level-two headings, not a heading that closes the operation from above.

CRITICAL — Invalid UTF-8 in semantic unit contents is silently rewritten. A Delta Section containing byte `0x80` in its normative prose delivers successfully: the archive retains `0x80`, while Formal receives U+FFFD. Delivery decodes bytes lossily in `src/core/change-sync.ts:44-45,57-66`, and preview does the same through `src/core/model/parser.ts:495-505`. Target verification compares the already-lossy interpretation, so it cannot detect the change. The correct result under `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/change-sync.md:19-25` is a source-path diagnostic before any write. `test/commands/output.test.ts:87-101` covers invalid UTF-8 in paths only. A committed test search for `autoLayot`, `NON_UTF8_UNIT_CONTENT`, invalid or malformed UTF-8 content/body/payload, and level-one or higher-level headings returned no matches.

reviews.summary: Reviewed the cumulative Change for completeness, correctness, coherence, and cleanliness. Two blockers remain: a retired Section operation can be misapplied as ADDED, and a linked archive parent can make abandonment appear in delivery history. HEAD did not move.
findings: CRITICAL — Preview and delivery accept a retired operation written as a Markdown level-two heading with a dash underline. After a valid `## ADDED Sections` block, `RENAMED Sections` followed by `----------------` is absorbed into the previous Section body; the following `### Section:` is then installed as ADDED. The parser recognizes only ATX headings as operation boundaries (`src/core/parsers/section-blocks.ts:21-28,193-226,239-260`), so both validation and the Formal round-trip accept the wrong target (`src/core/model/delta.ts:124-159`, `src/core/change-sync.ts:64-83`). An in-memory check of the committed code confirmed zero diagnostics and both Sections in the resulting Formal model. This violates `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/change-sync.md:19-25`. The existing regression covers ATX syntax only (`test/core/archive.test.ts:467-496`); `git grep -niE 'setext|underline(d)? heading|underlined sections' HEAD -- test tests` returned no matches.

CRITICAL — The two history locations are not guaranteed to represent distinct outcomes. If `archive/abandoned` is a pre-existing directory symlink to `archive`, the abandonment installs in ordinary delivery history but returns an `abandoned` path. A default retry then returns the same directory under the delivery path. The implementation follows the linked parent during reservation and lookup (`src/core/archive.ts:110-123,234-249,314-334`), and completion scans both paths without checking their parents (`src/utils/item-discovery.ts:40-51`). A filesystem simulation using the committed command confirmed both receipts for the same directory, with no concurrent writer. This violates Decision 4 (`.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/design.md:16`). `git grep -niE 'symlink.*history|history.*symlink|symlink.*abandoned|abandoned.*symlink|archive parent.*(symlink|junction)|(symlink|junction).*archive parent' HEAD -- test tests` returned no matches.

The existing compensation test keeps the destination present (test/core/archive.test.ts:1018–1049). Add a regression for a marker with no destination, including when opposite-mode history exists.

CRITICAL — A valid no-op delivery can fail on an unchanged, read-only Formal partition. The case check groups all original and target paths, including unchanged files (src/core/model/sync-writer.ts:150–165), and creates a temporary directory for every case-matching pair (src/core/model/sync-writer.ts:15–38). The transaction runs that check even with an empty manifest (src/core/change-sync.ts:80–92, 111–121; src/core/model/transaction.ts:274–292). On case-sensitive Linux, a valid Formal model containing distinct `Foo.md` and `foo.md` in a mode-0555 `elements` directory failed quick delivery with `EACCES` from `mkdtemp`, despite a `.delta-noop` and writable archive history. This violates the requirement to only archive when no model writes are needed (.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/change-archive.md:19–23). Limit probing to unresolved collisions involving paths the operation will install, and cover an unchanged case-distinct pair in a no-op delivery.

reviews.summary: The committed Change's own Semantic Delta compiles, passes notation validation, and round-trips through the Formal parser. Two blockers remain in the shared validation path: valid visible prose can be rejected, and malformed removal syntax can delete an existing Formal Section. HEAD remained unchanged.
findings: CRITICAL — A multiline HTML comment can hide valid prose after its closing delimiter. With `<!-- note` on one line and `### Section: Example --> Root SHALL keep this rule.` on the next, the parser correctly masks the comment and retains the visible sentence, but `extractSectionBody` tests the original line for a heading and skips it (`src/core/parsers/section-text.ts:116–129, 181–197`). The notation validator then reports missing Section text (`src/core/validation/validator.ts:185–205`), blocking preview and both delivery modes (`src/commands/validate.ts:199–208`, `src/core/change-sync.ts:64–79`). This violates Required Corrections 135 and 140 (`.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/tasks.md:135–140`). Reproduced against committed sources. The nearby cases in `test/commands/output.test.ts:506–538, 541–555` cover multiline comments and commented headings, but not a closing line that contains both a heading-like prefix and the Section's only visible rule; a targeted `git grep -nEi 'closing.line|section:.*-->.*(SHALL|MUST)|acceptance case:.*-->.*(SHALL|MUST)' HEAD -- test` found no such case.

CRITICAL — Invalid Markdown can remove an existing Formal Section. Under `## REMOVED Sections`, `###` followed by a nonbreaking space and `Section: Existing` is a paragraph, not a heading. The removal parser nevertheless accepts it because its selector regex uses `\s+` without requiring a Markdown heading (`src/core/parsers/section-blocks.ts:22–30, 218–232`). A committed-source probe confirmed that notation and compilation both pass and the prepared Formal output deletes `Existing` (`src/core/model/delta.ts:157–159, 361–385`; `src/core/change-sync.ts:64–84`). This violates the requirement to reject illegal Delta notation before delivery (`.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/change-sync.md:23–25`). Add a regression that asserts rejection and unchanged Formal and active Change state; `git grep -n -i -e 'non.breaking' -e '\\u00a0' -e '\\u000b' HEAD -- test` returned no matches.

reviews.summary: Reviewed Completeness, Correctness, Coherence, and Cleanliness. Archive retry can report old history as success while a newer attempt still requires inspection. HEAD was unchanged. After the build completed, the Linux suite passed 2,562 tests, with two skipped.
findings: CRITICAL — History lookup can hide an incomplete archive. Design decision 3 requires retries to identify a retained pending marker rather than return old history, even when rollback removed the destination (.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/design.md:15). But src/core/archive.ts:234–258 returns the first complete result in the preferred history directory before examining the other directory. If an abandonment fails, leaves its original source in staging, and removes its partial destination, a subsequent default or quick lookup can return an older delivery as `alreadyArchived` instead of reporting the pending abandonment. The committed regression test creates this state but retries only with `--abandon` (test/core/archive.test.ts:1074–1109), which searches the pending directory first. Check for matching pending markers in both history locations before selecting a completed receipt, and cover the opposite-mode retry.

reviews.summary: Reviewed Completeness, Correctness, Coherence, and Cleanliness against the cumulative Change. Two blockers remain: literal examples can pass the delivery gate as normative prose, and archive completion can advertise a history name that every archive mode rejects. HEAD was unchanged.
findings: CRITICAL — A literal code example can satisfy the normative Section gate. Required Correction at `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/tasks.md:153` says literal examples must neither trigger operations nor supply normative prose. `src/core/parsers/section-text.ts:128-147,190-208` protects inline code and raw HTML from structural parsing but leaves their text available to the SHALL/MUST check at `src/core/validation/validator.ts:185-206`. A read-only probe of committed code verified that a Section containing only a `<pre><code>` example passes `prepareChangeSync` and produces a Formal write; an equivalent fenced example is correctly rejected. Both delivery modes use that preparation at `src/core/archive.ts:379-398`. Add a regression that rejects code-only Sections without changing the stored bytes of examples alongside real normative prose.

CRITICAL — Archive argument completion offers blocked history as an archived Change. `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/tasks.md:129,154` requires name-based completion to exclude unfinished history and makes an unfinished marker in either history location take precedence over completed receipts. Lookup honors that precedence at `src/core/archive.ts:234-262`, but `src/utils/item-discovery.ts:40-53` checks only each dated directory's own marker, and `src/commands/completion.ts:291-298` drops the dates and advertises the remaining names. A read-only probe with a completed delivery and an orphaned same-name abandonment marker returned `demo` from completion discovery, while default, quick, and abandon all refused it as incomplete. `test/commands/output.test.ts:897-977` checks completion for different names and lookup for same-name history, but does not assert completion for the same-name case.

reviews.summary: Reviewed Completeness, Correctness, Coherence, and Cleanliness across the cumulative Change. Two blockers remain: the shared Section gate can both reject valid prose and accept code-only content, and a retry can move an active Change despite an unfinished archive of the same name. HEAD remained unchanged.
findings: CRITICAL — The Section gate does not reliably distinguish visible prose from literal HTML content. A read-only reproduction against committed HEAD showed that a multiline `<div>` attribute containing literal `<!--` masks the visible `Root SHALL retain the record.` that follows the tag, rejecting a valid Delta as missing Section text. Conversely, a Section containing only `<script>const example = "SHALL";</script>` passes archive preparation and produces a Formal write. The comment scan works line by line and the literal HTML exclusion covers only `pre` and `code` (`src/core/parsers/section-text.ts:118-174,221-248`); preview and both delivery modes use this gate (`src/commands/validate.ts:199-222`, `src/core/change-sync.ts:57-84`). This violates `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/tasks.md:130-135,153-156`. Add regressions for both directions; the existing cases cover single-line attributes and `pre`/`code` but not these cases (`test/commands/output.test.ts:568-605`).

CRITICAL — An unfinished archive is ignored when the active Change was restored and the retry selects another mode or date. The active path checks only the proposed destination’s marker, whereas the history-only path checks both locations and all indexed dates (`src/core/archive.ts:287-305,343-348`, `src/core/archive-paths.ts:74-83`). In a read-only in-memory reproduction, a restored active Change with a pending delivery was successfully moved by `--abandon`; the very next identical call failed on the old marker instead of returning the new receipt. That misses the retry inspection boundary in `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/design.md:15` and `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/tasks.md:89,151,154-157`. The existing restored-source test retries only the original destination (`test/core/archive.test.ts:1016-1038`). Check pending history before another move and cover cross-mode and cross-date retries.

reviews.summary: Reviewed the cumulative Change for Completeness, Correctness, Coherence, and Cleanliness. Two blockers were reproduced against committed HEAD: non-prose can satisfy Delta validation, and a lookup racing with rollback can return an older archive as a successful receipt. HEAD did not move during review.
findings: CRITICAL — Invalid Section prose can pass preview and delivery. Required Correction 158 (tasks.md:158) excludes scripts, styles, and templates from normative prose. In src/core/parsers/section-text.ts:146–160, 179–181, 204–223, HTML is examined in separate Markdown fragments, and a comment-closing suffix is limited to its current line. This loses literal HTML context across fragments. A committed-source probe confirmed that a Section whose only MUST is in a multiline script starting after `<!-- note -->`, or inside a template spanning a blank line, passes notation validation and produces a Formal write manifest. A Markdown link title containing the only MUST also passes because the raw link source is counted as prose. Both preview and delivery use this gate (src/commands/validate.ts:199–222; src/core/change-sync.ts:64–84; src/core/validation/validator.ts:185–206). The negative cases in test/commands/output.test.ts:553–589 cover isolated or same-line literals, but do not catch these inputs.

CRITICAL — A history lookup can report success for an older archive after the newer attempt rolls back. Archive checks the active directory once, then returns a historical receipt without checking whether the source was restored (src/core/archive.ts:274–293). If the newer destination and its marker disappear during inspection, history resolution falls through to an older receipt; completion also uses an active-name snapshot taken before that rollback (src/core/archive-paths.ts:73–111; src/commands/completion.ts:291–296). A deterministic in-memory probe reproduced `alreadyArchived: true` for the older receipt and an `archived` completion entry even though the active Change had been restored. This violates the rollback lookup requirement (tasks.md:101) and the receipt precondition (elements/change-archive.md:23, 53–55). The rollback test at test/commands/output.test.ts:1069–1095 has no older receipt, so it misses the fallback.

reviews.summary: Reviewed the cumulative Change for completeness, correctness, coherence, and cleanliness. Two independently reproduced blockers remain: an explicitly excluded parser behavior change and an Expected Model writeback failure in a state the Change itself creates. HEAD remained unchanged.
findings: CRITICAL [Coherence/Cleanliness] The Change alters shared Markdown/HTML behavior expressly excluded by `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/proposal.md:7–9`. The SAX-based literal-content handling in `src/core/parsers/section-html.ts:1–9,40–63` and the shared block classification in `src/core/parsers/section-text.ts:162–208,256–274` affect both Delta notation validation (`src/core/validation/validator.ts:192–205`) and ordinary Formal Contract reading (`src/core/parsers/section-blocks.ts:59–65,90–103`; `src/core/model/parser.ts:144–151`). Running the same inputs against committed base and HEAD confirmed two observable changes: a keyword inside a multiline script stopped satisfying the Delta keyword check, and a Section-shaped heading inside a multiline script stopped being returned by the Formal reader. Keep the required archive validation corrections, but separate the excluded shared-parser behavior or obtain explicit authorization for it.

CRITICAL [Correctness/Completeness] Reverting the last local Section can create a valid navigation-only sibling that then prevents saving a Section edit from the file that actually owns the Declaration operation. `src/core/model/delta.ts:309–318` indexes the navigation placeholder as a declaration source; `src/core/expected-model-writeback.ts:128–140` treats that index as operation ownership and drops the real local Declaration operation. The round-trip check then rejects the otherwise valid edit (`src/core/expected-model-writeback.ts:147–153`). In a committed-source reproduction, the edit returned `INVALID_TARGET` / `TARGET_ROUNDTRIP_MISMATCH` with the placeholder present and succeeded when only the placeholder was removed. The existing regression at `test/core/expected-model-writeback.test.ts:172–189` verifies the revert required by `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/tasks.md:110–111`, but stops before editing from the real owner. Distinguish navigation references from operation ownership and cover the two-edit sequence.

reviews.summary: Reviewed Completeness, Correctness, Coherence, and Cleanliness across the cumulative Change. The committed Linux build and 898 targeted tests passed, but the Expected Semantic Model contradicts the new archive completion behavior, and two CLI projections expose misleading results. HEAD did not change during review.
findings: CRITICAL — Archive completion contradicts the Expected Semantic Model. `.xirang/model/elements/completion-introspect.md:57–64` requires `archive` to use `change-id`, and `.xirang/model/elements/completion-command.md:120–127` excludes archive history from Change ID suggestions. The new implementation deliberately uses `archive-change-id` and offers finished archives (`src/core/completions/positional-types.ts:11–18`, `src/core/archive-paths.ts:92–108`), as required by `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/tasks.md:129–130`. Listing all four committed Delta partitions with `git ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD -- .xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/{metamodel,elements,relationships,views}` found no Delta for either completion contract. Update the contracts to distinguish Archive argument completion from ordinary Change ID completion.

CRITICAL — `xirang show --review --json` attributes a Declaration operation to a navigation-only placeholder, contrary to `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/tasks.md:111`. The compiler marks the placeholder `navigationOnly` (`src/core/model/delta.ts:309–319`), but the projection looks up operations globally by entity and identity, without checking source ownership (`src/commands/show.ts:60–75`). In a clean fixture with one real `MODIFIED` source and one Formal-matching placeholder, `show` reported `MODIFIED` for both files while preview reported one operation. The writeback test checks ownership in the compiled Delta, not the CLI projection (`test/core/expected-model-writeback.test.ts:172–198`); `git grep -n -E 'navigation|placeholder' HEAD -- test/commands/show.test.ts` returned no matches.

CRITICAL — The dated history completion endpoint does not share the retry decision required by `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/tasks.md:142–144`. `__complete archived-changes` checks each dated directory in isolation (`src/commands/completion.ts:290–302`, `src/utils/item-discovery.ts:40–53`), whereas `archive-changes` and retry resolve pending markers across both history roots (`src/core/archive-paths.ts:79–104`, `src/core/archive.ts:279–292`). With an older delivered `demo` and a newer orphaned abandonment marker for `demo`, the dated endpoint advertised the old receipt; the name endpoint suppressed it and retry correctly refused it. The cross-root test only asserts the name endpoint (`test/commands/output.test.ts:889–918`).

reviews.summary: Reviewed the cumulative Change for Completeness, Correctness, Coherence, and Cleanliness. The committed snapshot compiled and passed 716 Linux tests across 32 suites, with 2 Windows-only tests skipped. A separate CLI reproduction showed that Archive can report successful delivery without performing a declared Section removal. The managed Archive projection also retains parts of the retired Quality workflow. HEAD did not move.
findings: CRITICAL — Correctness/Completeness: A `REMOVED` Section can survive a successful delivery. `src/core/model/delta.ts:362–385` selects the first matching Section and removes only that occurrence. `src/core/change-compiler.ts:151–171` applies the operation before `src/core/model/validator.ts:203–229,255–264` checks for duplicate Section names, so a duplicate in Formal can become a single surviving Section and pass validation. On the isolated committed build, a Formal Element with two `Duplicated rule` Sections and a Delta removing that title produced a `MODIFIED` preview, a successful `archive --quick --yes --json` receipt, and a surviving `Duplicated rule` in Formal. This violates `change-sync.md:19–25` in the Change Delta and design decision 2's requirement to reject real precondition conflicts. Reject the ambiguous identity before applying it and add a regression that asserts preview and delivery fail without changing Formal or moving the active Change.

CRITICAL — Coherence/Cleanliness: The Archive skill no longer runs or repairs Quality (`src/core/templates/workflows/archive-change.ts:139–145`), but the managed Archive-only projection still includes the obsolete execution-model dispatch and ships all Apply references, including Review, Opt, Seal, and Quality recovery (`src/core/shared/skill-generation.ts:42–68,75–91`; `src/core/templates/workflows/archive-change.ts:177–184`; `src/core/templates/workflows/apply-change.ts:282–293`). `test/core/workflow-installation.test.ts:223–251` explicitly requires that stale projection even when the Apply skill is absent. This leaves the managed surface half-migrated against design decision 5 and the Change Delta's Apply-only Quality execution boundary.

CRITICAL — Cleanliness: The standalone Sync removal orphaned `parseSemanticDelta` (`src/core/model/delta.ts:297–299`). `git grep -nE 'parseSemanticDelta\b' HEAD -- src ':!src/core/model/delta.ts'` returned no matches, and the package exports do not expose it (`src/index.ts:1–2`; `src/core/index.ts:1–12`). Its remaining callers are tests; unlike the production entry at `src/core/change-compiler.ts:151–155`, it cannot supply the Formal baseline needed to validate navigation placeholders. Remove the obsolete wrapper and exercise the production parser or compiler boundary instead.

reviews.summary: 审查了累计 Change 的完整性、正确性、一致性和整洁性。HEAD 未变动。TypeScript 构建及 32 个相关测试文件通过，但预期语义模型与已实现的 Archive 工作面仍有一处契约冲突。
findings: CRITICAL — 一致性：`.xirang/model/elements/quality-cli-gate.md:61–63` 仍要求为 Apply 和 Archive 投影覆盖 Review、Opt、Seal 和 CAS 的协议参考文件。Required Correction 148 则明确要求 Archive-only 投影不附带 Apply 专属参考文件（`.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/tasks.md:145–150`）。实现遵循该修正：Archive 只投影 Git 参考文件（`src/core/templates/workflows/archive-change.ts:173–196`）；安装测试确认 Apply 的协议参考文件不会被安装（`test/core/workflow-installation.test.ts:222–255`）。`git ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD -- .xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements | grep -F '/quality-cli-gate.md'` 无匹配，因此归档应用 Delta 后仍会保留旧契约。应更新该 Section，将 Review/Opt/Seal 执行协议投影限定为 Apply，并明确 Archive 只消费 Seal、报告诊断及交回 Apply；不应恢复 Archive 的 Apply 专属参考文件。

reviews.summary: 独立审查了完整 Change 的完整性、正确性、一致性和整洁性。HEAD 在审查期间未变化。归档参数补全在并发提交窗口内会误把正在归档的 Change 标为已归档，违反未完成历史的补全契约。
findings: CRITICAL — `src/core/archive-paths.ts:44-89,92-104` 混用了历史目录旧快照和活动目录的新状态，`src/commands/completion.ts:289-293` 将结果直接输出。复用一个已有历史回执的 Change 名称时，若新归档在历史枚举之后、活动目录检查之前创建 `.pending` 并移走活动源，补全不会检查新归档的标记，反而输出旧回执对应的 `demo\tarchived change`。用提交源码和内存文件系统复现：开始提交前建议为 `active`，同一次补全跨过提交边界却建议为 `archived`，在同一未完成状态下重新补全则不建议该名称。这违反 `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/completion-command.md:20-23`。现有 `test/commands/output.test.ts:915-950,1008-1079` 验证了预先存在的标记和读取期间的回滚；`test/integration/archive-workflow.test.ts:98-128` 验证了另一归档提交期间读取历史。针对历史枚举后开始提交的测试搜索无匹配。请修正跨快照的判定，并用确定性交错测试覆盖此方向的竞争。

reviews.summary: Reviewed the cumulative Change for Completeness, Correctness, Coherence, and Cleanliness. HEAD did not move. Two blockers remain: the interrupted-delivery acceptance case contradicts the pending-marker rule, and delivery can report target validation failures against nonexistent source paths.
findings: CRITICAL — Interrupted-delivery behavior and its acceptance test disagree with the contract. `.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/change-archive.md:49–51` says the next `--abandon` after a kill following Formal writes archives the Change without rolling back Formal. But `src/core/archive.ts:100–124` creates the pending marker before Formal can be written, and `src/core/archive.ts:279–285,343–348` rejects that marker before entering abandonment. This rejection matches the later Required Correction in `tasks.md:152`. The test at `test/core/archive.test.ts:335–354` simulates the interruption without the marker, so it does not establish the advertised retry behavior. Align the acceptance case and test with the pending-marker rule, including what happens before and after manual inspection.

CRITICAL — Delivery reports a guessed path instead of the actual Delta source for target-model validation failures. The Change Sync contract requires diagnostics to identify the semantic unit and path (`.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/change-sync.md:23–25`). `src/core/change-compiler.ts:67–88,160–170` resolves application diagnostics to Delta sources but does not do so for target validation diagnostics. An in-memory run of committed HEAD with an Authored View at `metamodel/nested/display.md` and an unresolved `of` reported `views/view.md`, which did not exist. `src/core/change-sync.ts:71–73` forwards that path to Archive. Add a regression test with a noncanonical source path; the same-name diagnostic test at `test/core/change-compiler.test.ts:113–128` cannot detect this failure because its source already matches the guessed path.

reviews.summary: Reviewed the cumulative Change for Completeness, Correctness, Coherence, and Cleanliness. The 20 committed Delta units compiled and round-tripped through the Formal reader in memory. HEAD did not move. Diagnostic attribution, the completion contract, and completion test coverage still need correction.
findings: CRITICAL — Required Correction 153 is incomplete. Target validation reports relationship errors as diagnostics on the source Element, not on the relationship triple (`src/core/model/validator.ts:170–199`). The compiler therefore locates the Element file instead of the actual relationship operation source (`src/core/change-compiler.ts:55–68`), and both Archive and Validate expose that wrong path (`src/core/change-sync.ts:64–74`; `src/commands/validate.ts:199–212`). An in-memory probe adding an undeclared relationship in `relationships/actual-source.yaml` returned `elements/custom/path.md`. The existing endpoint regression asserts only the error code (`test/integration/validate-command.test.ts:89–99`); `git grep -nE 'UNDECLARED_RELATIONSHIP_KIND.*path|INVALID_RELATION_ENDPOINT.*path|path.*UNDECLARED_RELATIONSHIP_KIND|path.*INVALID_RELATION_ENDPOINT' HEAD -- test` returned no matches. Attribute relationship diagnostics to the triple and test the actual Delta and Formal container paths.

CRITICAL — The modified completion-introspection contract still requires a `quality optimize` subcommand (`.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/completion-introspect.md:26–30`). The committed CLI registers `opt`, and the positional map and reflector expose that exact name (`src/commands/quality.ts:19–47`; `src/core/completions/positional-types.ts:59–63`; `src/core/completions/introspect.ts:36–38,80–97`). An in-memory reflection probe confirmed `review`, `opt`, `seal`, and `status`. Correct the Delta to say `opt`; adding a CLI alias would change behavior outside the authorized scope.

CRITICAL — There is no regression assertion for excluding a historical receipt whose original Change name is the reserved `archive` (`.xirang/changes/atomic-change-archive/elements/completion-command.md:20–23`). Runtime filtering exists in both providers (`src/commands/completion.ts:289–301`; `src/core/archive-paths.ts:127–136`), but the completion test creates only ordinary historical names (`test/commands/output.test.ts:880–925`). `git grep -nE '202[0-9]-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-archive([^a-z-]|$)' HEAD -- test` returned no matches. Removing either reserved-history filter would survive this coverage; add a dated reserved-name receipt to the existing completion test and assert it is omitted from both outputs.

reviews.summary: Reviewed Completeness, Correctness, Coherence, and Cleanliness across the cumulative Change. The three archive modes, Formal write and rollback boundary, history lookup, completion routing, and Agent handoff are supported by the committed implementation and tests. TypeScript checks passed; 1,077 tests passed and two Windows-only tests were skipped on Linux. HEAD was unchanged.
